tool_args.rationale: The pilot covers H ≤ 0.48, far short of the target H = 24.9. The slow-horizon probe directly tests and calibrates the proposed endogenous reversal.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the dual-exponential model from pilot rows alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations cannot reliably identify the slow adaptation governing the target horizon.
More short-horizon detail would not directly resolve the long-horizon reversal.
It does not address the identified horizon ambiguity.
